content: In this paper, we describe the deep neural network architecture we used for the Visual Storytelling Challenge 2018. The problem to solve in this challenge can be stated as follows: Given a sequence of 5 images, the system should output a story related to the content and events in the images. Our architecture is an extension of the image description architecture presented by BIBREF0 . We submitted the generated stories to the internal track of the Visual Storytelling (VIST) Challenge, which were evaluated using the METEOR metric BIBREF5 as well as human ratings.
